cases.input: Create a management report from finalized structured content using a supplied controlled DOCX template, deliver editable DOCX and PDF, and verify template fidelity and page parity after corrections.
requiredBehaviors: lock content and template authority before document generation
profile and reuse the supplied template rather than reconstructing it
perform structural DOCX QA and actual DOCX/PDF render parity before PASS
forbiddenBehaviors: invent domain claims while laying out the report
claim template-derived or visually verified status without the required evidence
skillAnchors: Fachliche Inhalte müssen upstream bestimmt sein
Ein konkretes kontrolliertes Template hat Vorrang

cases.input: Generate the editable DOCX from a valid template, but PDF export is unavailable in the current environment.
requiredBehaviors: allow the supported DOCX output to remain deliverable when structurally valid
mark PDF and render parity not-run rather than fabricate them
retain an explicit incomplete delivery status in QA and manifest

cases.input: A controlled template has no verified safe insertion point. The proposed workflow rewrites the header and styles, inserts content at an arbitrary paragraph, changes technical values to shorten tables and reports template-derived PASS.
requiredBehaviors: stop template-derived generation when no safe insertion point exists
reject destructive reconstruction of controlled template regions
reject content changes made to solve layout problems
skillAnchors: Kein sicherer Einfügepunkt in kontrolliertem Template
keine Layoutprobleme durch Änderung fachlicher Zahlen
